title: Pickleball Flame
style: country, female vocal high tones. dreamy message, positive, old rock roaring 50's
lyrics:
game begins, right on cue . 
diffrent mind set, different view.
pickleball flame,
 running tgrough my vein
become centered, focused and true.
your paddle becomes an extention of you

feel it, drop, feel it, pop, givin it everything you got! we are here, for success. always playing at your best.

make the most of your tools, they are all that you got .
hands... feel it on the paddle, 
eyes....allow you to anticipate , 
now im  not late
im right on time
using my sences 
make. this.  game. mine.

i won you over,
you know its true
lives within my heart
could never be blue. 

 trust in you! 

*whisper"
only you can make "your" dreams come true.

you, me, 
us, we, 
pickleball forever, 
can you feel its power.
